item.title: San Marcos leaders reject plans to build controversial data center
item.description: San Marcos leaders have rejected plans to build a new data center in the city after a lengthy city council meeting.Hundreds showed up to weigh in on the proposed center Tuesday night. item.description: The board passed a new rule for the system broadly defining the freedoms students and educators have to teach and learn undefined topics.

item.title: APD looking for 2 men who burglarized jogger's car, used stolen credit cards

item.title: ATP picks contractor for Austin Light Rail, construction to start in 2027
item.description: The Austin Light Rail is moving another step forward.The Austin Transit Partnership (ATP) has picked Austin Rail Constructors (ARC) as the contractor to build the light rail project, a step towards beginning construction in 2027. ARC was picked after a yearlong procurement process. They'll also bid portions of the work to subcontractors.ATP says the project will bring lots of jobs and economic opportunity.
